title: security compliance review prep 1:1 - sam
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep with Priya (Security Lead)
Date: 2026-03-02 (proposed)
Goal: Quick sync to align on SOC2/ISO readiness status, vendor risk blockers, and next audit prep steps.

Agenda (rough)
- Quick status (5m): where we are vs target for next quarter (SOC2 Type 1 in staging, ISO gap analysis ongoing)
- SOC2 controls to confirm (15m):
  - Access controls: MFA coverage, SSO integration status across infra and console (owner: infra-team)
  - Change management: PR review evidence and deployment logs (owner: release-eng)
  - Logging & monitoring: retention windows, alerting on suspicious activity (owner: observability)
  - Incident response: tabletop schedule + postmortem templates (owner: SRE)
- ISO27001 overlaps and outstanding docs (10m):
  - ISMS scope doc: need final sign-off from legal (linked doc)
  - Asset inventory: missing items from private-deployments teams
- Vendor risk / third-party (10m):
  - Top 5 vendors with high risk score: cloud provider billing, KMS provider, observability vendor, backup provider, model registry (owner: procurement/security)
  - Outstanding items: SOC reports requested but not received (Vendor-A), contract addendum for data processing (Vendor-C)
- Audit readiness checklist & evidence gaps (10m):
  - Evidence matrix (confluence) - highlight gaps we must close before auditor kickoff
  - Sample requests: 3 PRs spanning last 6 months, a user deprovisioning record, a backup restore test report
- Quick blockers + action items (5m)

Prep notes / facts to remember
- Auditor kickoff date tentatively: 2026-04-15 (needs confirmation)
- Target: complete Type 1 readiness items by 2026-03-31
- Current high-risk gaps: incomplete vendor SOC reports, incomplete asset inventory for private deployments, inconsistent retention settings in some observability pipelines
- Recent incidents: minor SSO misconfig (2025-11) - postmortem done but need to paste the artifacts into confluence page and confirm NFR mapping

Evidence/Docs to bring to 1:1 (quick links)
- SOC2 Readiness Checklist (confluence) - https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SOC2+Readiness+Checklist
- Evidence matrix spreadsheet (sheet id: SEC-EVIDENCE-2026)
- Vendor risk register - JIRA-SEC-412
- Backup restore runbook + latest test results (team: infra)

Action items (draft, assign now)
- Priya: confirm auditor kickoff and share scope + auditor contact by 2026-02-25 (ASSIGNED)
- Maya: pull vendor SOC reports for Vendor-A and Vendor-C and upload to confluence by 2026-02-27 (ASSIGNED)
- Jamal: update asset inventory for private-deployments (missing hosts list) and tag owners by 2026-03-03 (ASSIGNED)
- Sam (me): collect sample PRs and deprovisioning evidence, add links to evidence matrix by 2026-02-26 (ASSIGNED)
- Infra owner (TBD): validate retention settings across logs/metrics and provide config snapshots by 2026-03-01 (REQUESTED)
- Release Eng: export deployment audit trail for last 6 months and add to evidence store by 2026-03-04 (REQUESTED)

Potential risks to flag in the meeting
- If auditor kickoff slips past mid-Apr, compression of remediation time could push Type 1 beyond Q2.
- Vendor SOC delays: may require compensating controls; need buy-in from procurement/legal.
- Private deployment asset gaps: unknown hosts could cause scope creep for auditors.

Notes to self (things to ask Priya)
- Any updates from legal on DPA addendums for model hosting vendors?
- Do we want to run a dry-run tabletop the week of 2026-03-15? Suggested scope: incident detection -> escalation -> external comms.
- Are we comfortable with current evidence retention periods for demo requests from auditors? If not, propose extending to 12 months for logs relevant to SOC2 in the interim.

Follow-up plan after 1:1
- Update evidence matrix and push to confluence with a clear owner/deadline column (Sam)
- Create a short status slide for weekly exec sync (one slide: red/amber/green + 3 top blockers)
- Schedule a vendor push for missing SOC reports (Priya + procurement)

Random TODO scratch (personal)
- Add missing links to evidence sheet (ticket: JIRA-OPS-999)
- Remind release-eng to tag PRs with 'audit-evidence' label when merging

End of notes.

(Informal / scratchpad: not final - will tidy before sending meeting invite)
